plugins.description: Twenty-four composable engineering skills for Claude Code on a governed multi-agent workflow engine: a front-door guide that routes any situation to the right skill, codebase comprehension with recovered ADRs, pipeline/parallel/loop orchestration under explicit harness and loop policies, per-node model routing with lite/balanced/all-out execution modes, and lifecycle coverage from design, algorithms, patterns and UI craft through review, testing, integration, release, operations and incident response, to an autonomous propose-only improvement loop.
